_comment: Tier-2 for febio::damage#2, syntax half. <Dmax>1.0</Dmax> is accepted and runs; 1.2 and -0.1 are rejected AFTER the deck reads SUCCESS, with 'Invalid value for parameter:' followed by '.Dmax' — the fixture asserts the name before the dot is EMPTY (i.e. 'Material1.Dmax' does not appear), because that is the detail that stops a reader searching for a material name. The mesh-dependent softening half of that pitfall is NOT asserted here and is named as uncovered. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
